_metadata.description: Chrome-DevTools-style visual filters applied to the preview iframe: color-scheme toggle and vision filters (blur, grayscale, three colorblindness modes).

requirements.title: Color-scheme toggle (system/light/dark) posts a class to the harness child via the bridge
requirements.description: A three-way toggle posts a bridge message `colorScheme: 'system' | 'light' | 'dark'`. The harness child applies `color-scheme: <value>` on `:root` and toggles a `dark` class as needed.

validation.notes: UI component test toggles the control, asserts the bridge message is posted with the expected payload.

requirements.title: Vision-filter dropdown applies SVG-defined filters to the iframe
requirements.description: Options: none, blur (0–10px slider), grayscale, protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia. Implemented via hidden SVG `<filter>` defs on the host page; `filter: url(#...)` is applied to the iframe wrapper. Colorblindness matrices match the values used by `app-monitor`'s `DeviceVisionFilterDefs`.

validation.notes: Component test asserts dropdown selection updates the wrapper's `filter` CSS to the expected `url(#...)` value.
